reason: The picture shows glucose entering liver cells and being joined into a stored carbohydrate, matching the goal.
expectation: Some of the meal glucose will be stored inside the liver cells.

effect: The result shows that liver cells store some glucose as linked carbohydrate and can break the store down when other tissues need fuel. The goal is complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the glucose become a store, though the pairing was predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the glucose-containing blood with liver cells was worthwhile because it connected an absorbed meal to fuel storage between meals.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter was very brief: its only pairing was already shown in the picture, so there wasn't much to figure out.

surprise.text: The result added that the liver can break down the store again when other tissues need fuel.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary; the picture and goal both explained the pairing.

continue.text: I might continue to see how the stored fuel reaches other tissues, but this short, predictable chapter alone isn't a strong hook.
